```{=html}
<style>
  /* --- 404: a small De Stijl composition --------------------------------- */
  .m404 {
    --m-white:  #f7f4ec;
    --m-black:  #15110d;
    --m-red:    #d4332b;
    --m-blue:   #1850a8;
    --m-yellow: #f6c915;
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 2.5rem auto 4rem;
    padding: 0 1rem;
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* The painting: a 4x4 grid where black "grid lines" are the gaps showing
     through a black backing, and the 404 lives in the big white field. */
  .m404-grid {
    width: min(440px, 82vw);
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-template-rows: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-template-areas:
      "num num num red"
      "num num num red"
      "num num num yel"
      "blu wht wht yel";
    gap: 6px;
    background: var(--m-black);
    border: 6px solid var(--m-black);
  }
  .m404-grid > div { background: var(--m-white); }

  .m404-grid .num {
    grid-area: num;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 14vw, 7rem);
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
    color: var(--m-black);
    user-select: none;
  }
  .m404-grid .red { grid-area: red; background: var(--m-red); }
  .m404-grid .yel { grid-area: yel; background: var(--m-yellow); }
  .m404-grid .blu { grid-area: blu; background: var(--m-blue); }
  .m404-grid .wht { grid-area: wht; }

  /* The composition breathes a little on load. */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .m404-grid .red,
    .m404-grid .yel,
    .m404-grid .blu {
      animation: m404-fill 0.6s ease both;
    }
    .m404-grid .red { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
    .m404-grid .yel { animation-delay: 0.20s; }
    .m404-grid .blu { animation-delay: 0.35s; }
  }
  @keyframes m404-fill {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  }

  .m404-text { margin-top: 2.25rem; }
  .m404-text p {
    margin: 0.15rem 0;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
  }
  .m404-text .lead-es { font-weight: 600; }
  .m404-home {
    display: inline-block;
    margin-top: 1.75rem;
    padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--m-white);
    background: var(--m-red);
    border: 3px solid var(--m-black);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: box-shadow 0.12s ease, transform 0.12s ease;
  }
  .m404-home:hover {
    color: var(--m-white);
    box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 0 var(--m-black);
    transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
  }
</style>

<div class="m404">
  <div class="m404-grid" role="img"
       aria-label="404 — page not found, in a Mondrian composition">
    <div class="num">404</div>
    <div class="red"></div>
    <div class="yel"></div>
    <div class="blu"></div>
    <div class="wht"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="m404-text">
    <p class="lead-es">Esta página se salió de la cuadrícula.</p>
    <p>This page fell outside the grid.</p>
    <a class="m404-home" href="/">Volver al inicio · Back home</a>
  </div>
</div>
```
